svg.title: Component legacy assessment breakdown
svg.desc: Horizontal component rows across Accepted, Action-Required and Legacy. Diamonds plot calculated central component indices; bars plot calculated lower and upper indices. Confidence is interval precision, not probability or evidence quality. The local calibration is distinct from government classification.
svg.metadata: Input SHA-256: af2ae97a82a490b3000623dd20b2760e6ce9f6dac3669e8b1883a625980ea89d; calculation version: 1.2.0; component chart version: 4

g.text: Local calibrated component index; independent of government classification and numerical risk

g.title: Payments application (payments_app). Actual classification Undetermined. Index unavailable, range 0.000–3.000. Local calculation, not a government score.

g.text: Bar: calculated lower–upper range. Diamond: calculated central estimate, not the range midpoint.
¹ Confidence = range precision: 100 × (1 − interval width / 3). High ≥80%, medium ≥50%, otherwise low.
This is a local ArcKit plotting convention, not a probability, readiness percentage or published government score.
Each criterion is calibrated at baseline=0, action-required=1 and legacy=2; the strongest indicator determines the component index.
Missing indicators extend the upper bound to 3 and suppress the diamond. Labels retain exact bounds for narrow ranges.
Recorded classifications remain separate. Raw measurements, calibration and evidence references are in the report.
